mechanism: Benztropine's anticholinergic effects may reduce GI motility and increase zoledronic acid exposure through delayed gastric emptying, while zoledronic acid can cause electrolyte abnormalities and GI disturbances that are compounded by anticholinergic activity.
action: Monitor for increased GI side effects and electrolyte abnormalities; ensure adequate hydration and consider timing separation of administration; assess necessity of benztropine use.
